source.label: FY2025 Form 20-F, cash income taxes paid
source.quote: Supplemental disclosures of cash flow information: Payment of income tax Income tax paid was RMB 26,476 million, RMB 32,486 million and RMB 33,409 million for the years ended March 31, 2023, 2024 and 2025, respectively.

notes: Taxes: us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaid, the caption does not say whether refunds are netted. R&D not reported as a separate line. Alibaba reports 'Product development expenses' (RMB57,151 million for FY2025; tagged us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense in XBRL). The 20-F says they primarily include costs for research and development personnel and development of new technologies, but it does not say the line is R&D, so it is not recorded under the ‘only if the filing says it is R&D’ rule.
